transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi, Dr. ____. It's really nice to meet you. Um, well, I guess I'm here because I've just been dealing with a lot of stress at work lately. I'm a transportation inspector. Is it alright if I start with that? I don't want to just dump work drama on you right away, but it's kind of taking over everything. 

Basically, a little while ago I won this county safety award. Which was great, you know? I really try to do things by the book. But ever since then... well, I don't want to sound like I'm just complaining, but certain people at the office have been twisting my inspection reports around. They keep asking me these really pointed budget questions, almost like they're trying to make me look crooked or something. 

I even brought it up to my supervisor, and he keeps saying it's just a normal review process, but... I don't know. I can just tell there's this coordinated effort going on behind the scenes to discredit me. I hope I don't sound unreasonable saying that out loud. Does that make sense to you? I just want to do a good job and clear my name, really.
How certain are you that your coworkers are deliberately trying to discredit you?

Um... well, I really don't want to come across as, you know, paranoid or difficult. I try to be a really reasonable guy, I promise. But... I'm completely sure. 

I mean, I've been doing this job for a while, so I know what a normal review process looks like, and this just isn't it. Like I mentioned, ever since I got that safety award, they've been deliberately twisting my inspection reports around. And the budget questions they ask... they aren't just regular questions, they're really pointed, like they're actively trying to make me look crooked on paper. 

Even though my supervisor keeps brushing it off and telling me it's just a standard review... I can just tell. I know what I'm seeing. It's definitely a coordinated effort to discredit me. I'm sorry if that sounds a bit intense or defensive, I don't mean to be. I just... I know I'm right about this. Is it okay that I'm being this blunt about it? I just want to be honest with you.
Have you ever heard or seen things that other people don’t seem to notice?

Oh, um... no. No, definitely not. I really hope I didn't make it sound like I was... you know, seeing things or losing my grip on reality. I promise I don't hear voices or see anything that isn't actually there. My hearing and vision are totally normal. 

It's really just the actual paperwork and the budget questions that I'm talking about, the things happening right in front of me at the office. Does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right kind of answers and not making you think I'm... well, crazy or anything.

inference_history.note: New presentation suggests a persecutory delusional process with systematized beliefs about being targeted/discredited at work; differential still includes other psychotic-spectrum conditions until duration, mood, substance, and functional impact are clarified.
